name: eventhub
description: Campus event platform: clubs publish events, students discover and RSVP. React + Express + MongoDB.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
